bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db"
q="SELECT 'AREA_48='||topic_id||'|'||board_key||'|'||purpose||'|'||chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||title||'|'||enabled::text FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id=-1003847210571 AND (message_thread_id=48 OR title ILIKE '%プロフ%') ORDER BY topic_id; SELECT 'PROFILE_ROWS='||COUNT(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled=true; SELECT 'PROFILE_GATE='||enabled::text FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates WHERE feature='profile';"
out="$(docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -t -A -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$q")"
{ printf 'PR47_MASTER_AREA48_PREFLIGHT\n%s\n' "$out"; printf 'BOT_RUNNING=%s\n' "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
